episode.title: Backstage Costume Chaos
episode.scene: A neon-lit carnival dressing room at night, bathed in dramatic purple and acid green light. Two fluffy hamsters stand tangled inside a giant, oversized purple and green jester hat with gold bells, their little paws poking through the seams with wide, startled eyes. In the background, a vanity mirror reflects playing card motifs string-lit with glowing bulbs.
episode.caption: Trying on the crew uniforms didn't quite go to plan. Hat is definitely wearing them today! 🎪🐭✨
episode.arcNote: The hamsters attempted to try on the carnival's backstage costume pieces and got hilariously stuck inside a giant jester hat.
episode.arcUpdate: The hamsters are fully embracing their new backstage crew roles, despite wardrobe malfunctions.
